title: add benchmark-lab adaptive-batching reporting pipeline v81
author: Anya Patel
description:
Motivation: expose adaptive-batching metrics end-to-end for the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline so we can track batching efficiency, per-model token utilization, and scheduling impact across representative workloads. This PR wires together the new reporting DAG, adds CI for nightly runs, and provides a templated dashboard and CSV export for downstream cost analysis.

What I changed:
- New reporting pipeline: benchmark-lab/pipelines/adaptive_batching/reporting_pipeline.py (DAG that aggregates adaptive batching traces, computes batch efficiency, and exports normalized metrics)
- Config: benchmark-lab/configs/adaptive_batching.yaml (schedules, thresholds, export targets)
- Profiling baselines: benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/adaptive_batching_baseline.json (baseline metrics for model families)
- Representative runners: benchmark-lab/runners/representative/adaptive_runner.py (runner that emits batch-level traces and payload metadata)
- CI: infra/ci/benchmark-lab.yml (nightly job + smoke test)
- Tests: benchmark-lab/tests/test_reporting_pipeline.py (unit + integration smoke)
- Docs: docs/benchmark-lab/adaptive-batching.md (usage and dashboard notes)

Checklist:
- [x] Pipeline logic implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Integration smoke test added to CI
- [x] Baseline artifacts included
- [x] Dashboard template and CSV exporter validated locally
- [x] Linear cards linked

Notes: the pipeline is backward-compatible with existing reporting schemas; when baseline payloads are missing the pipeline falls back to per-run normalization. We intentionally keep the scheduling window conservative (5m) to avoid adding load to the canary hosts.

Merge notes: squash merge. See release notes below for visibility.
commits_summary: feat(adaptive-batching): add reporting DAG and metric computations
test(ci): add nightly benchmark-lab job and smoke test
docs: add adaptive-batching guide and dashboard template
review_comments: Jordan Kim: Left a few nits around logging and one place where exceptions could drop metric keys. Requested a small refactor to metrics_normalizer to make fallback behavior explicit.

Anya Patel: Addressed Jordan's comments; added explicit fallback and unit tests covering missing baseline cases.

Pushed follow-up commit that extracts normalizer to utils/metrics_normalizer.py and updates callers.
Priya Singh: Verified pipeline on staging with representative runners; noted that the default export retention should be configurable. Suggested adding TTL config in adaptive_batching.yaml.
Anya Patel: Added TTL config and a note in docs. Ran CI again; nightly job passed locally and on the CI runner.
Ethan Brooks: Approved. Quick perf sanity check looks good (no regression on existing reporting pipelines).
release_notes: Add adaptive-batching reporting pipeline (v81): new DAG to aggregate adaptive-batching traces, baseline artifacts for normalization, representative runner for batch-level captures, nightly CI job, and dashboard template for batch efficiency and per-model token utilization exports.
